scenarios.S7: Clean Ubuntu 24.04 (Wayland and X11): .deb installs, launches, adds a folder via the system picker, indexes, searches, opens a result, Install AI gives search without chat on CPU; X11 shortcut registers, Wayland shows the --focus-search alternative; uninstall/reinstall keeps data
scenarios.S8: Linux in-app update via descriptor v2 and pkexec apt-get: success relaunches the new version; cancelled prompt, lock timeout or failure resumes the old Engine and re-offers the update
scenarios.S21: The MCP bridge's manifest and registry entry carry the app's version, the release URL and checksum, declare Linux and Windows, and the bridge works on both (J8)
scenarios.S22: Journeys run on clean installs without a developer JDK, models or inherited runtime paths; a missing download, skipped or unavailable check is reported as such, never as a pass
scenarios.S-Windows-update: Windows in-app update via descriptor v2 from a VM-local mirror: success relaunches the new version with data kept; a cancelled elevation or failed install resumes the old version and re-offers
scenarios.S12: Linux with a supported NVIDIA GPU: Install AI fetches Linux GPU packs and chat answers with sources on the GPU; preview, install and readiness agree on what the plan includes (isIncludedByPlan native-target gate) (does not block the release)
scenarios.S14: Soak J9: 60 min on the GPU with long documents, steady progress, no crash loop, memory under its guard; only when indexing/enrichment/inference changed
scenarios.Isolation: The lane never reads or changes the owner's own JustSearch data, settings, running instance or desktop session; its processes, ports and state are private and removed after the run (prove with a sentinel in the owner's real data folder and a check that no owner-visible window appeared)
